shared_adapter: New shared daily reference function receives explicit tmean/min/max, ea, 2m wind, pressure, measured/model solar radiation, elevation AND supplied extraterrestrial radiation in MJ/m2/day. It uses the previously verified daily FAO algebra and Hargreaves coefficients. Earth supplies FAO astronomical radiation; a fantasy caller must supply its own world geometry and all meteorological variables. Never substitute Earth latitude/day geometry or invented humidity/wind for missing fantasy inputs. Existing immutable audited kernel and legacy atlas remain unchanged.
temporal_mapping: Compute daily Hargreaves and PM from identical weather at each fixed grid point. Sum each actual Gregorian calendar month within each year, then average the five same-month totals. The12totals map conservatively to the existing12equal model bins; spread by actual model-bin/step duration. Annual bin sum exactly reproduces mean of the five annual daily totals, including leap days. This is an explicit climatology/phase approximation, not observed model-calendar daily weather.
